notes.notes: Game is now windowed to fix bug where it gets stuck between two monitor screens.

notes.title: Weapon Rebalance and Bot AI Overhaul
notes.notes:
[b]Weapon Rebalance[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapons have varied health and energy to balance strength of move set
[*] Weapons have unique combos that have significant value in the weapons overall strength
[*] Weapons work better with updated tempo system now
[/list]

[b]Bot AI Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*] Bots filter out bad moves a lot better
[*] Bots lookout for their own combos and their opponent's combos
[*] Bots use the 'Wait' move better based on energy, health, and temp now
[/list]

notes.title: Weapon Overhaul
notes.notes:
# Offensive
light attack (0 cost, 1 damage)
heavy attack (4 cost, 3 damage)
charged attack (2 cost, 2 damage)(deals damage through block, doesn't negate effects)
lunge (1 cost, 2 damage)
riposte (1 cost, 1 damage) (stuns against neutral moves)
slam (3 cost, 2 damage) (disables defensive moves if blocked)
siphon (1 cost, 1 damage) (+1 health if successful)

# Defensive
parry (1 cost) (1 damage against offensive moves)
defend (2 cost) (stuns against offensive moves)
guard (1 cost) (+3 energy against offensive moves)
ward (1 cost) (+1 health against offensive moves)
barrier (2 cost) (disables offensive moves if attacked)
dodge (1 cost) (avoid damage against offensive moves)

# Neutral
grab (1 cost) (+3 energy against defensive moves, stuns opponent)
kick (1 cost) (stuns against defensive moves, deals 1 damage)
feint (2 cost) (2 damage against defensive moves)
taunt (1 cost) (+1 health against defensive moves)
shout (2 cost) (disables defensive moves if blocked)
wait (0 cost) (+5 energy)


# Combat Triangle
Offensive > Neutral > Defensive > Offensive

notes.title: Update Notes for July 9
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added new tempo mechanic
[list]
[*] Successful attacks add one tempo
[*] With at least 2 tempo, players gain their tempo - 1 back in energy each turn
[*] With at least 3 tempo, players deal 1 additional damage on attacks
[*] With at least 3 tempo, players will heal 1 health on successful parries or defends
[*] With at least 5 tempo, successful grabs will set your opponents energy to 0
[*] Any unsuccessful turns will reset your tempo to 0
[*] If you have 5 or more tempo and it gets reset, your opponent will heal 1 health, gain 3 energy, and get an extra tempo
[*] Waiting with at least 1 tempo allows you to consume it, healing 1 health for each tempo consumed.
[/list]
[/list]
